I'm excited to share with you our proposed shooting schedule, which spans 10 days, from the start of production to the final wrap. Our team has carefully planned the sequence of scenes to ensure a smooth and efficient shoot.

Each day is packed with key scenes: we'll kick off with exterior shots at the State Legislature and County Courthouse, followed by interior scenes at these locations. We'll then move on to the Campaign Headquarters, Debate Stage, and Lakeside Estate, before wrapping up at the Downtown Newsroom. 

I'm pleased to report that we were able to stick to the original constraints, without needing to make any compromises. This schedule is the optimal plan, and we're confident it will deliver the high-quality footage we're aiming for.

In terms of budget, our total cost comes in at $10,900.00, which is well within our allocated budget of $4,200,000.00. This leaves us with plenty of room for any unexpected expenses or opportunities that may arise during production.

Overall, I believe this schedule sets us up for success, and I'm looking forward to bringing this project to life. Let me know if you have any questions or if there's anything else I can do to support you.
